greet.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
greet.text: Come in, come in. The coffee is hot. You are new here, I can tell. Nobody walks that slowly who has lived here long.

zone.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
zone.text: I came out of the zone. They told us three days. Pack what you can carry, they said, and you will be back by Friday. I took the kettle and my mother's cups. That was three years ago.

move.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
move.text: When they brought us here, the town did not know what to say. So a neighbour brought bread, and nobody asked a single question. I still use the cups. Every day. Someone has to.

work.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
work.text: If you need work, ask at the post office. They always need couriers. Walk fast, keep the parcels dry, and you will be paid by the end of the day.

clerk.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
clerk.text: Before anything else, see the town clerk at the desk on the square. He keeps the register. A person who is not in it is no one at all, here.

handbook.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
handbook.text: And read the handbook. It is short. It tells you what the town expects of you, and what the police will not forgive.

bye.voice_name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
bye.text: Come back when you are hungry. Or lonely. It is the same to me.

voice.name: Mariva Viva Muse - Warm and Energetic
